case.summary: On 2016-12-28, card C08299-K1 was used for an online transaction of $30.02, and the cardholder first reported they did not make the purchase. The cardholder later confirmed the transaction was theirs, and the $30.02 amount has been charged to this card 5 times across 3 distinct months under the same product code at a median of 34 days apart, a cadence that policy R7 forbids blocking. The 5 closed cases CC-2836, CC-5529, CC-2412, CC-0842, and CC-2891 closed as 5 confirmed fraud with 0 cleared, the card sits in a giant device-sharing component of 2,500 cards, and known fraud pattern 2 describes card-not-present fraud as ambiguous online purchases requiring verification under policy R1 to R4. The evidence conflicts and the verdict remains uncertain at probability 0.45, with exposure of $30.02 if the activity is fraudulent under case ID CC-2836.
